entries.knownHazards: Although no specific mention has been made for this species, there have been reports that some members of this genus can cause photosensitivity in susceptible people. Many species also contain oxalic acid (the distinctive lemony flavour of sorrel) - whilst not toxic this substance can bind up other minerals making them unavailable to the body and leading to mineral deficiency. Having said that, a number of common foods such as sorrel and rhubarb contain oxalic acid and the leaves of most members of this genus are nutritious and beneficial to eat in moderate quantities. Cooking the leaves will reduce their content of oxalic acid. entries.knownHazards: The leaves are poisonous[21, 62, 76, 95]. They are said to be safe to eat when young, the toxins developing as the plants grow older. Another report says that the seeds and root are poisonous. The plant sap can cause dermatitis in sensitive people[222]. The plant contains substances that cause cell division and can damage chromosomes. These substances can be absorbed through any abrasions in the skin, potentially causing serious blood aberratins, and so it is strongly recommended that the people wear gloves when handling the plant[222, 274]. Avoid during pregnancy. Even children consume even 1 berry emergency poison treatment should be instituted. Up to 10 berries are considered harmless for adults [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Lapai, sėklos ir šaknis toksiški; augalo sultys dirgina odą ir gali sukelti dermatitą. Augalas turi medžiagų, pažeidžiančių chromosomas — jos absorbuojamos per odos įpjovimus, todėl tvarkant būtina mūvėti pirštines ir vengti nėštumo metu. Vaikams net viena uoga reikalauja skubios pagalbos; suaugusiems iki 10 uogų laikoma nekenksminga.
entries.knownHazardsLtEdited: Lapai, sėklos ir šaknis toksiški; sultys palietus odą gali sukelti dermatitą. Augale yra medžiagų, pažeidžiančių chromosomas — jos patenka į organizmą per odos įpjovimus, todėl tvarkant būtina mūvėti pirštines; nėštumo metu venkite. Vaikams net viena uoga reikalauja skubios medicinos pagalbos; suaugusiems iki 10 uogų laikoma nekenksminga.
entries.changesNotes: 'augalo sultys dirgina odą ir gali sukelti dermatitą' → 'sultys palietus odą gali sukelti dermatitą' (natūralesnė konstrukcija, pašalyta redundancija). 'Augalas turi medžiagų' → 'Augale yra medžiagų' (pagal taisyklę). 'absorbuojamos per odos įpjovimus' → 'patenka į organizmą per odos įpjovimus' (vengiama kalkės). 'skubios pagalbos' → 'skubios medicinos pagalbos' (tikslesnis).
